summary.text: Janet Tweed is the Democratic candidate for the New York State Assembly, District 102, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Republican Marcus Molinaro.
A physical therapist who serves on the Delhi Village board, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that improving healthcare affordability and access is her top priority.

paragraphs.text: Janet Tweed earned a bachelor's degree from Elizabethtown College in 2003 and a graduate degree from Thomas Jefferson University in 2006, and she also lists Utica College in 2021.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a physical therapist who has worked mainly in hospitals in urban and rural settings, as well as in home health.
She said she has served on the Delhi Town board and the Delhi Village board.
Tweed advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.

She said her priorities include passing the New York Health Act, expanding school-based health centers, providing tuition forgiveness for providers who work in underserved areas, and increasing housing stock.
She also said she has never taken money from corporate political action committees.
